_comment: Neutral-site games. The NCAA feed carries no neutral flag — its isHome
only marks the nominal home side, which at a neutral site is whoever the
bracket seeded higher. So a game at Allen Fieldhouse is home, everything
else defaults to away, and the exceptions live here.
update-seed.py also auto-detects a neutral site when KU plays two or more
different opponents at the same non-Allen venue in one season (a holiday
tournament or a conference tournament), so those need no entry. List a
venue here only when a single visit is neutral — typically a postseason
Keys are 'date|normalized opponent'; run scripts/update-seed.py to see the
site it derived for every game.

games.2026-03-30|byu: WBIT championship at Charles Koch Arena, Wichita — a neutral floor, not BYU's

venues.T-Mobile Center: Kansas City showcase and Big 12 Tournament games
